title: Wso2am: authenticated attacker can craft a disposition frame with large or illegal ranges causing excessive CPU usage…
description: A vulnerability in the wso2am package allows an authenticated attacker to craft a disposition frame with large or illegal ranges, causing excessive CPU usage due to naive range handling. This can lead to a denial of service condition. The issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 and has been assigned CVE-2026-66276. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
